page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8a.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T24 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

Given its high memory-to-CPU ratio of 8:1, the ecs.r8a.12xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local high-speed disk storage or GPU acceleration. It is designed for workloads such as medium-to-large databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
